# llms.txt — placeholder

> This file is regenerated per-client at build time by the Generate-Site
> pipeline (Phase 5e, see scripts/generate-pages.mjs + AGENTS.md). The
> default template ships this stub so the route resolves with HTTP 200
> against any unparameterized template deploy. The final per-client file
> follows the pattern documented in reference_seo_aeo_site_baseline:
>
> - One-paragraph brand description
> - Quick facts (service area, niche, pricing band, lead time)
> - Contact (email, phone, social handles from brand-config.json)
> - Pages list with one-line purpose each
> - Common questions list (mirrors faqs from brand-config.json)
